text:
jamie: quick ping — PR #20612 is ready for merge but we're hitting intermittent timeouts in the mac e2e matrix. nightly freeze starts in ~3.5h, can someone help rerun or give quick 👍 so we can land before freeze? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/20612 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ci-bot: test run #5942 failed: `mac-e2e-11` timed out after 45m. Flaky on `browser-window.test.ts` 

maria: ugh, seen that flake before. usually a rerun fixes it. @alex can you kick a rerun? :pray:

alex: on it — running the targeted job now: `./ci/retry --pr 20612 --job mac-e2e-11` (should be quicker than full matrix)

ci-bot: rerun queued (targeted). ETA ~12m. Queue position 3.

tay: if the rerun is still flaky we should consider landing with `canary=true` and short-lived feature flag to minimize risk. avoids having to wait for full matrix green before the freeze.

jamie: prefer not to flag if we can avoid it — change touches routing only, low surface area. but good fallback plan.

sam (oncall): FYI if this stalls for >30m we can ask infra to bump mac capacity for reruns, but that's last resort. ping me if queue stays stuck.

ci-bot: rerun finished: `mac-e2e-11` ✅ passed. Full matrix still running (2/6).

alex: full matrix just turned green (all checks ✅). I added `merge-ready` label and left a short note on the PR asking releng to prioritize landing before freeze.

deploy-bot: Reminder — nightly freeze window starts 2024-05-23T23:00:00Z. Merges after freeze will enter sandbox queue.

maria: giving a quick 👍 now. jamie, if you need me to watch the canary post-merge I can do a sweep at +30m. :thumbsup:

jamie: thanks everyone — proceeding to merge. will ping if any post-merge regressions. :rocket:
